stemMd: Which point is the reflection of (−3,5) across the vertical axis?
explanationMd: Reflection across the vertical axis changes the sign of the horizontal coordinate and leaves the vertical coordinate unchanged. Thus (−3,5) becomes (3,5). The distances to the axis are equal on opposite sides.

distractorRationale.d: This reflects across the horizontal axis.
distractorRationale.b: This swaps coordinates instead of changing the horizontal sign.
distractorRationale.a: This combines an unrelated swap and sign change.
